dict.string: iTrucker's Co-Driver uses your microphone to listen for voice commands so you can keep your hands on the wheel and eyes on the road.
iTrucker's Co-Driver uses speech recognition to understand your voice commands for navigation, fuel stops, rest areas, hours of service logging, and more.
iTrucker's Co-Driver uses your location to find nearby fuel stops, rest areas, truck stops, and to provide accurate weather conditions along your route.

iTrucker's Co-Driver can monitor your heart rate, heart rate variability, and sleep to detect fatigue and help you stay safe on long hauls. This is opt-in only — your raw health data never leaves your device.
iTrucker's Co-Driver does not write health data. This permission is requested by the HealthKit framework but not used.
